# Microplastics Reference Library

> Source-traceable literature on microplastics in products and ingredients, operated by the Institute of Contaminant Standards. The library connects study-specific findings to the original papers and explains their methods and limitations. Its canonical website is https://microplasticsindex.com.

## Reference sections

- [Products](/products): food-contact and household products.
- [Ingredients](/ingredients): food and beverage occurrence studies.
- [Topics](/topics): indoor, wildlife, and human exposure context.
- [Testing](/testing): methods and measurement context.
- [Regulations](/regulations): agency material with its source and scope identified.
- [Sources](/sources): original studies and official agency material supporting the collection.

## Reading the evidence

- [Plastic food storage](/products/plastic-food-storage): tubs, bags, wraps, and containers, with release measurements, methods, and evidence limits.
- [Editorial and evidence approach](/methodology): source identity, reported values, study-specific interpretation, and evidence gaps.

Category pages are selected literature syntheses, not exhaustive systematic reviews. Keep the material, test conditions, size range, and analytical method with each finding. A measured release under a specific test condition does not, by itself, establish everyday exposure or a health effect. Follow the numbered references to the source records and original papers.

## How to cite

Use the visible "Cite this page" block on the specific reference page, including its title, displayed update date, and canonical URL. The published format is:

Microplastics Reference Library. [Page title]. Updated [displayed date]. [Canonical page URL].

Link to the specific page used. Cite the original paper when discussing its findings and retain its study conditions and limitations.

## Contact and operator

The library is operated by the Institute of Contaminant Standards, a trade name of Paleo Certified, Inc. See [About the library](/about) and the [Institute of Contaminant Standards website](https://contaminantstandards.com).
